audit_results.query: Synthesize the overall marine ecosystem health report for the Southwest coast of India.
audit_results.sql_executed:
SELECT b.scientific_name, b.family, b.genus,
       b.minimum_depth_m, b.maximum_depth_m,
       b.event_date, b.decimal_latitude AS lat, b.decimal_longitude AS lon,
       b.basis_of_record
FROM public.marine_biodiversity b
WHERE b.decimal_latitude  BETWEEN 8.0 AND 25.0
  AND b.decimal_longitude BETWEEN 55.0 AND 77.0
ORDER BY b.event_date DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30;
